ddcl.ponder.tag.dimmable_cage_lamps.desc: Lamps that can change the emitted light
ddcl.ponder.dimmable_cage_lamps.text_1: Dimmable Cage Lamps can change their brightness by varying the redstone power of the block.
ddcl.ponder.dimmable_cage_lamps.text_2: If you right click on the block, the operational mode will be switched.
ddcl.ponder.dimmable_cage_lamps.text_3: Now the lamp's behavior is reversed...
ddcl.ponder.dimmable_cage_lamps.text_4: When there is no power, the lamp has max brightness...
ddcl.ponder.dimmable_cage_lamps.text_5: And when it's fully powered, it's off
ddcl.ponder.double_texture_dimmable_cage: Copper lamps have one more feature that the others don't have.
If you right click with a wrench...
The lamp changes to the old copper texture.
